notes: Merges in a public GET /api/services endpoint (restricted to the smm.plus CORS origin) that serves a cached copy of smm.plus's own retail service catalog (price/min/max, synced daily from https://smm.plus/api/v2) filtered by an admin-configured landing-page category slug, with optional geo/lang filtering - for SEO landing pages that currently hardcode pricing. New SEO > Catalog Services (synced list, manual sync action, admin-set source label) and SEO > Landing Categories (slug-to-category mapping) admin pages, plus an smm.plus API key/host/currency field on SEO Settings. This build also corrects the previous 1.27.30 update, which was mistakenly built from an older codebase and overwrote PanelSection.php, breaking the Analytics page installed by 1.31.0 ("Undefined constant PanelSection::ANALYTICS") - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
